mistake_reason: At step 22, the orchestrator explicitly announced a session reset and discarded all prior validated progress (Gazetteer-based identification of Seattle as largest and Cathlamet as smallest county seats by land area), without any user request or critical error. This forced the team to re-acquire data and rely on Wikipedia infoboxes for land areas, where they incorrectly selected Davenport as the smallest county seat, leading to a wrong population difference. This behavior matches FM-2.1: Conversation Reset—an unwarranted restart that lost context and caused failure.
